# Kestrra

> Kestrra is the name Tarik Ramadani works under: photography, film, color grading, and websites, apps and software, based in Belgrade, Serbia, working across Europe. English and Serbian.

- Photography: events, people, stage and concerts, clothing brands, sport, nightlife, corporate events.
- Film: shooting music videos and promos, and color grading.
- Development: websites, web apps and software, design and build.
- Prices are quoted per project; there is no price list. Inquiries: https://kestrra.com/inquiry or hello@kestrra.com, Instagram @kestrra.
- Clients include Red Bull Serbia, the Olympic Committee of Serbia, IDJ Videos, Bassivity Music, 2Hot4Stage, Elite Restaurant & Club Zürich, Studentska asocijacija FON-a, Društvo za mikrostrukturna i nanostrukturna istraživanja Srbije, and Apartment Renovation NYC.
- Published in Vogue Adria: "Young artists in Serbia: ten years of Inter/Akcija" (photos by Tarik Ramadani), https://vogueadria.com/young-artists-in-serbia-interakcija/
- Tarik studies computer science at the University of Belgrade (Faculty of Mathematics).
- All photographs are © Tarik Ramadani. Licensing: https://kestrra.com/license

## Pages

- [Development](https://kestrra.com/dev): websites, apps and software, with live links
- [About](https://kestrra.com/about): who Tarik is, clients, contact
- [Inquiry](https://kestrra.com/inquiry): the form for a shoot, a film or a build
